note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, and only soldiers and workers are described, the descriptions and measurements being taken from Holmgren 1911, 1913 and Ahmad 1958; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, mandibles brown with yellow base, antennae uniformly coloured, not darkened apically. Pilosity of head very sparse, consisting only of fine setae; pilosity of thorax and abdomen denser, setae at the abdominal apex slightly longer. Body length 3.0–3.5 mm. Head oval, slightly narrowed anteriorly, moderately strongly arched (length including mandibles 1.7–1.82, length excluding mandibles 0.98–1.17, width 0.98–1.10 mm). Antennae 16-segmented; segment 2 equal in length to segments 3 and 4 together; segment 3 longer than segment 4, subequal to segment 5. Labrum oval. Mandibles sickle-shaped, incurved; left mandible (length 0.67 mm) with a pointed tooth at the beginning of the apical third (tooth distance 0.15 mm); right mandible with a small tooth placed slightly behind the tooth of the left mandible. Postmentum moderately strongly arched, slightly longer than wide, widest at the middle (length 0.70, width 0.49 mm). Pronotum slightly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe large; narrower than the head (length 0.39, width 0.72–0.80 mm), both anterior and posterior margins weakly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow, body white. Pilosity of head slightly denser, otherwise as in the soldier. Body length 3.0 mm. Posterior part of head rounded, sides slightly divergent anteriorly; longer than wide, gently arched (length 1.48, width 1.24 mm). Antennae long, 17-segmented; segment 2 longer than segment 3. Postclypeus slightly inflated, shorter than half the width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior lobe large, both anterior and posterior margins very weakly concave (width 0.65 mm).
